CPU.type: metadata mocks only; no SSH/GPU/owner start

semantics.release: same actual hold text SHA, explicit arm/host scope, allowed current host, no active own job, no startup/world16 reservation, exact full 0..7 capacity at 79000MiB
semantics.probes: at most two capacity probes per tick; cached successes/failures plus immediate per-tick host reservation
semantics.launch: only selected newly free host; unchanged worker separately checks UUID/leases/known owner with 79000MiB floor
semantics.running_release: matching hold receipt prevents repeated STOP, no repeat capacity probe
semantics.changed_hold: old release invalid; operator new hold stays held even after previous process exit
semantics.failure: existing real failure review required; no retry or optimizer reset authority
semantics.receipt: run.capacity_resume_release and append-only run.capacity_resume_receipts, persisted by sole main owner CAMPAIGN write
